description.narrative: INTThe Project will work with Pacific regional partners, primarily CROP agencies as well as regional NGOs, and engaging with national government and non-government stakeholders to progress the implementation of the 2050 Strategy for the Blue Pacific Continent in alignment with supporting the acceleration of SDG 2030 Agenda; providing a set of targeted offerings and interventions aimed at empowering partners that are also representatives of marginalised communities to effectively drive their own agendas to ensure inclusive, people-centred, accountable and resilient development. Empowering local communities representing people living with disabilities, women, youths and indigenous that will demonstrate transformation and impactful inclusive developments solutions in key areas of the sustainable development agenda. The 3 outputs are designed to promote innovative, inclusive, gender sensitive targeted programming that responds to the evolving needs, while simultaneously offering seed development solutions to the region. The Project will tap into UNDP’s comparative advantages as a trusted neutral broker with access to comparative good practice from around the world that can be tapped for the benefit of the region. Delivery will be made through3 complementary streams of work: (1) provision of high-quality expertise and knowledge to Pacific partners to inform national and regional policy development and decision-making (2) incubation of innovative, inclusive cutting edge regional and/or national programming, in particular in support of resilient, inclusive and accountable development and (3) supporting regional and national partners, UN agencies and UNDP teams to integrate GESI programmes across their policy and programming work.

title.narrative: Thematic Evaluation: Thematic Evaluation: UNDP’s Contribution to Women’s Leadership and Empowerment in the Pacific at Mid-Term Stage of Implementation of the Multi Country Programme Document, 2023-2027
